question: If an AI worker can log into our accounts and act in our name, what should it never do without us?
reflection: Agents that take over routine tasks could give people more time for care and creativity, if trust is earned step by step.

sources.subject: xAI Grok Bot logs into your tools autonomously, $120/seat

one_line: AI agents that sign into everyday tools and work alone are now on sale, while open alternatives arrive for free.

top_stories.title: An AI worker that logs in for you
top_stories.what: xAI launched Grok Bot, which runs on its own cloud computer, signs into browser tools like a person and keeps working after you leave, from 120 dollars per user each month.
top_stories.why: Agents that can negotiate or reply in your name raise urgent questions about consent and accountability.

top_stories.title: DeepSeek shares a free agent kit
top_stories.what: DeepSeek released an early open framework where every part of an agent, from the model to memory, is a swappable plug-in with a full action log.
top_stories.why: Open, logged agent kits let research teams build and audit their own tools.

top_stories.title: Very fast answers from a top model
top_stories.what: OpenAI offered a preview of a high-speed tier of its leading model on Cerebras chips, reportedly up to 14 times faster.
top_stories.why: Near-instant answers make real-time voice and support services more natural.

saudi_lens.text: Agents that act in a person's name touch Saudi rules on digital identity and e-signatures, so public bodies may need guidance before staff use them.

idea.title: Acting-on-my-behalf rules
idea.pitch: Draft clear rules for which tasks an AI agent may do in an employee's name, and test how staff and customers react to them.
idea.first_step: List ten common tasks and sort them into allowed, needs approval and never.

idea_kids.title: Helper permission cards
idea_kids.pitch: A card set where children decide which jobs a pretend helper may do alone, which need a grown-up, and which they must always do themselves.
idea_kids.first_step: Draw twelve simple job cards, such as tidying toys or opening the door.

terms.definition: The software around an AI model that gives it tools, memory and a way to act.
When an AI controls a computer by clicking and typing like a person.
A record of every action taken, so people can check later what happened and who did it.
